HIKE DRY: The Women's Klamath hiking boots are water resistant to help repel rain in the event of unexpected showers. Should you need to step through a fast-flowing stream or puddle, feet will dry out quickly thanks to built-in drainage and breathable mesh uppers for airflow. This breathable design is preferable to waterproof boots that restrict airflow, leaving your feet hot and sweaty. Trust Eddie Bauer to all your outdoor gear needs. Founded in 1920 by mountaineer and gear designer with a passion for quality, we continue honoring his legacy with every piece of footwear, clothing, and technical gear we create. We hope to inspire you get outside and #LiveYourAdventure .
